sessionWarmUp.title: Warm up camera sessions before HomeKit asks
sessionWarmUp.description: Opens a camera’s connection as soon as it reports an event, so the first live view or snapshot afterwards starts straight away instead of waiting for a cold connection to open. The cost falls on cameras that run on their own battery: warming one up keeps it awake for several minutes, and a camera that reports often may never sleep. Cameras wired to power, or attached to a HomeBase, are unaffected either way. "Doorbell presses" is the balanced choice — somebody is at the door every time, so the cost is always repaid. "Detections too" gives the fastest live view on motion and person alerts, and is the option to pick if your cameras are wired or if you would rather have the speed than the battery life.

oneOf.title: Off — never open a connection early
Detections too — faster live view, more battery use
